$schema: Evidence card — a single piece of debate evidence
title: EvidenceCard

tag.description: Tag/tagline — one-sentence claim this card proves

accessed.description: Date URL was accessed (NSDA requires for online evidence)

quotedText.description: VERBATIM quoted text — the source's actual words, not a debater's summary

paraphrased.description: True if paraphrase. NSDA permits paraphrasing IF full citation is given and held to the same accuracy standard.

highlightedSpan.description: Optional portion of quotedText to read aloud (highlighted region)
